proved_mathematical_statements: Complete monomial centralizer classification of standard DFT over C
No exact DFT from any pure-diagonal-gauge Margulis Green-sum/product network, even with strongly asymmetric weights
Positive operator-norm approximation gap for all unitary diagonal gauges at even square length with s>=4
For Zariski-generic gauge, fewer than N/2 changed vertex-weight occurrences cannot turn a gauged symmetric network into an exact DFT
No exact Fourier factorization as one arbitrary invertible weighted-permutation Green inverse and one rook-supported factor, in either order, for square side s>=3
Conditional relative-Frobenius approximation bound for fixed-point-free single Green followed by row-d-sparse operator
Exact finite N=4 positive control: two mixed-axis four-resolvent Green-sum layers
important_qualifications: s=2 half-y permutation is affine, but its translation b=1 fails 2b=0 modulo 4
Unitary-gauge norm gap does not apply to nonunitary diagonal similarities
k changes are counted per resolvent occurrence, not per shared parameter
The k>=N/2 defect statement requires a Zariski-generic gauge D, not all gauges
One-Green plus rook no-go does not apply to sums of multiple Green solvers
The finite N=4 factorization does not extend by itself to unbounded N
research_result: An exact architecture-specific obstruction and a reproducible small positive example; no universal speed breakthrough
